answerability_accuracy.definition: valid answer abstains iff fixed test flag says unanswerable; not semantic answer accuracy

abstention_correct.definition: valid fixed-fallback response on unavailable-information controls

unsupported_claims.definition: unsupported plus insufficient_evidence divided by valid judged claims, including unlisted claims
unsupported plus insufficient_evidence divided by valid judged claims, including unlisted claims

faithfulness.note: An automatic provisional faithfulness estimate, not answer accuracy; human calibration required.

latency_note: retrieval plus generation service time; judge and scheduler/backoff waits excluded, not end-user wall time; cached rows retain historical generation timings

e2e_accuracy.reason: No independent answer-adequacy rubric measured; claim faithfulness is not question completion

tokens_scope: Known usage in saved stage results, including historical cache hits; failed transport-attempt usage may be unavailable
list_price_scope: Equivalent price of known saved-stage tokens, not current-invocation API consumption or actual billed spend
billing_note: No billing evidence collected; list prices are dated assumptions, not actual spend
provisional_reason: Synthetic draft corpus/test labels and human judge calibration pending or limited
